τοῖιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen./dat. dual, epic τοῖιν (= Attic τοῖν): ’of those two’
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τρὶς: τρίς — three times, thrice; numeral adv.
τρῶάς: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. acc. pl., accent shifted before the enclitic τε (Τρῶας θ’)
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), in a consequence: ’in that case, then’ (τώ κε … ἀντήσειε ’then would he meet’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’on that account, therefore’ (τὸ καὶ κλαίουσα τέτηκα ’and so I waste away weeping’) · also τὸ πρῶτον, adverbial: ’at first’ (ὡς τὸ πρῶτον ’as at first’) · also τὸ πρίν, adverbial: ’before, formerly’ · also τὸ τέταρτον, adverbial: ’for the fourth time’ · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὸ δ’ ἐμὸν κῆρ ’and my heart’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὸ ποιήσαντο ’which they made’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’)
τῇσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic ταῖς): ’for them’
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these, of them, of which’ · also gen. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τῶν ἄλλων Τρώων ’the other Trojans’)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin or body parts serves as a possessive); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
φαίνετο: φαίνω — show; mid. appear, seem; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἐφαίνετο)
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’
χάλκεος: χάλκεος — of bronze, bronze; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦς)
χαλκόποδ: χαλκόπους — bronze-footed, bronze-hoofed; masc. acc. dual, elided (χαλκόποδ’ = χαλκόποδε), agreeing with ἵππω
χροΐ: χρώς — skin, body; masc. dat. sg., epic χροΐ (= Attic χρωτί)
χρυσέῃσιν: χρύσεος — golden; fem. dat. pl., epic uncontracted -έῃσιν (= Attic χρυσαῖς), agreeing with ἐθείρῃσιν
χρυσείην: χρύσειος — golden, of gold; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κυνέην
χρύσεα: χρύσεος — golden; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσᾶ)
ἀάπτους: ἄαπτος — meaning unknown (traditionally ’untouchable’ or ’irresistible’); fem. acc. pl., agreeing with χεῖρας
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀκροτάτης: ἄκρος — topmost, highest; superl. ἀκρότατος, fem. gen. sg., agreeing with κόρυθος: ’the very top (of the helmet)’
ἀλαοσκοπιὴν: ἀλαοσκοπιή — a blind man’s watch, a careless lookout (ἀλαός ’blind’ + σκοπιή ’watch’); fem. acc. sg.
ἀλκῆς: ἀλκή — might, valour, prowess in battle; fem. gen. sg.
ἀμβρόσιον: ἀμβρόσιος — ambrosial, immortal, divine; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἀμφοτέροισι: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also masc. dat. pl., indirect object of ὄπασσον: ’to both’
ἀμφοτέρω: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. acc. dual, agreeing with a dual noun: ’both’ · also masc. nom. dual, in apposition to a dual subject (τὼ … ἀμφοτέρω ’the two, both’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀολλέες: ἀολλής — all together, in a body; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀολλεῖς)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπαμειβόμενος: ἀπαμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. nom. sg. masc.
ἀπιόντος: ἄπειμι — go away; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., in a genitive absolute: ’as he went away’
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’) · also adv. ’away, off’ before πρό (ἀπὸ πρὸ νεῶν ’off in front of the ships’) · also + gen. of manner: ’from’ (ἀπὸ σπουδῆς ’in earnest’) · also with a noun in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπὸ νευρῆφιν ’from the string’)
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀργείους: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also ἅλς (masc.) — salt; masc. gen. sg., partitive: ’of salt’
ἄαπτοι: ἄαπτος — irresistible, invincible (sense and origin uncertain); fem. nom. pl., agreeing with χεῖρες
ἄλλο: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg.: ’another thing’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an unexpressed verb: ’else’ (οὐ … ἄλλο ’nothing else’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with an understood πῦρ: ’the other’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλῃ: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. dat. sg. used adverbially: ’elsewhere’
ἄμοτον: ἄμοτον — insatiably, unceasingly, eagerly; adv. (neut. acc. of ἄμοτος)
ἄνακτα: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. acc. sg.
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἐθείρῃσιν: ἔθειρα — hair, mane (of horses); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic ἐθείραις)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐλάαν: ἐλαύνω — drive; epic pres. inf. of the by-form ἐλάω, with diectasis (contracted ἐλᾶν; Attic pres. inf. ἐλαύνειν): ’to drive on’
ἐλέαιρε: ἐλεαίρω (epic by-form of ἐλεέω) — pity; pres. imper. act. 2 sg.: ’pity!’
ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’coming’ · also aor. part. masc. dual nom., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντε): ’the two having come’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐννοσίγαιος: ἐννοσίγαιος — ’earth-shaker’, epithet/name of Poseidon (built on γαῖα, distinct from ἐνοσίχθων built on χθών); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνοσίχθων: ἐνοσίχθων — earth-shaker, epithet of Poseidon (from ἔνοσις ’shaking’ + χθών ’earth’); masc. nom. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’) · also adv., ’next, after them’ (τοῖσι δ’ ἐπ’ Ἰδομενεύς ’and after them Idomeneus’) · also + dat. of place, ’close by, hard by’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ τάφρον ὄρυξαν ’dug a ditch close by it’) · also + dat. of time, ’within, in’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a single day’)
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπεβήσετο: ἐπιβαίνω — set foot upon, mount (+ gen.); aor. mid. 3 sg., epic -σετο (= Attic ἐπέβη): ’mounted’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + dat. ’on’ · also + acc., ’to, towards’ · also in ὅσσον ἐφ’ …, ἐπί of unclear attachment: ’(lying) on, at’ · also + dat., ’against’ (Τρωσὶν ἐφ’ ἱπποδάμοισιν ’against the Trojans’) · also + gen., ’by oneself’ (ἐφ’ ὑμείων ’by yourselves, apart’) · also + gen., ’upon’ (ἐφ’ ὑμετέρων ὀχέων ’upon your chariot’) · also + gen., ’over, around’ (ἐφ’ ὁμίλου ’over the crowd’)
ἐχέμεν: ἔχω — have, hold, keep in check; pres. inf. act., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἔχειν): ’to hold’ · also pres. inf. as an imperative: ’hold!’
ἐϋκνήμιδες: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom./voc. pl.
ἑοῦ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive, epic enlarged ἑός) — his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. ἑοῦ, agreeing with παιδός
ἑστάμεναι: ἵστημι — set; stand; perf. inf. intrans., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἑστάναι), after χρή: ’to stand’
ἔα: ἐάω — let be, allow, leave alone; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’leave alone!’ · also εἰμί — be; impf. 1 sg., epic ἔα (= Attic ἦν): ’I was’ · also ἐάω — allow; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= εἴα): ’allowed’
ἔβαλε: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’struck, hit’ · also ’put, laid’ in tmesis (ἐν … ἔβαλε ’laid on’)
ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’
ἔγνων: γιγνώσκω — recognise, know; aor. 1 sg.: ’I recognised’
ἔγωγ: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε, elided (ἔγωγ’ = ἔγωγε): ’I for my part’
ἔδμεναι: ἔδω — eat; pres. inf., epic -μεναι (= Attic ἐσθίειν): ’to eat’
ἔδυνε: δύνω (by-form of δύω) — put on, enter; impf. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’put on’
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented (ν-movable): ’put, placed’ · also ’made, caused’, with a predicate acc. or a dat.
ἔλπετο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ᾔλπετο): ’he hoped’
ἔλποντο: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; impf. 3 pl. mid. (deponent)
ἔμπεδον: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unbroken; adj., neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’steadily’ · also neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’steady’
ἔνερθε: ἔνερθε — below, beneath; prep. + gen., also adv.: ’below’
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, correlative of ὅθεν
ἔστησε: ἵστημι — set, station, halt; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’halted, stood’
ἔστι: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., accented ἔστι at clause start: existential, ’there is’ · also impersonal + inf.: ’it is possible’ (οὐδέ πῃ ἔστι … εὐχετάασθαι)
ἔχουσι: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. 3 pl. act.: ’they hold’
ἕζετ: ἕζομαι — sit down; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἕζετ’ = ἕζετο), in tmesis with κατά: ’sat down’ · also plain, no tmesis: ’sat’ (ἕζετ’ ἔπειτ’ ἐπὶ θῖνα ’then sat down on the shore’)
ἕκτορα: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. acc. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἠγνοίησεν: ἀγνοιέω (Attic ἀγνοέω) — fail to recognize, not know; aor. 3 sg. act., negated by οὐδέ: ’did not fail to recognize’
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ), correlative with ἠέ · also ’than’ after a comparative (γλυκίων … ἠὲ νέεσθαι ’sweeter than to go home’) · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question (ἠὲ φυλάσσονται νῆες ’whether the ships are guarded’; ἠὲ κατ’ αἶσαν ἔειπον ’whether I spoke in due measure’)
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’ · also ’than, except’ after ἄλλος (ἄλλῳ γ’ ἢ Ἀχιλῆϊ ’than Achilles’) · also in τί ἢ ἐμέ, a form of τίη: ’why’ (τί ἢ ἐμὲ ταῦτα διεξερέεσθε ’why do you ask me these things’) · also ἢ = ἦ, ’truly, surely’ (ἐπεὶ ἢ πολὺ φέρτεροί ’for they are truly far better’)
ἤϊξε: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented ἤϊ- (= Attic ᾖξε): ’darted’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἰών: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱμάσθλην: ἱμάσθλη — whip, lash; fem. acc. sg.
ἵκετο: ἱκνέομαι — come to, reach, befall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, + acc.
ἵππω: ἵππος — horse; masc. acc. dual: ’two horses’ · also masc. nom. dual: ’the two horses’ (ἵππω πλήξαντε ’the two horses, striking’)
ἶσοι: ἶσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. pl.: ’like’
ὀλύμπιος: Ὀλύμπιος — Olympian; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Zeus
ὀχέων: ὄχος — chariot, car (usually pl. ὄχεα); neut. gen. pl.
ὀϊλῆος: Ὀϊλεύς — Oileus, father of the lesser Ajax; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg. · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὁ γέρων ’the old man’)
ὁμίλῳ: ὅμιλος — throng, crowd, gathering (esp. of men); masc. dat. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄλυμπον: Ὄλυμπος — Olympus, home of the gods; masc. acc. sg.
ὄρεος: ὄρος — mountain; neut. gen. sg., epic uncontracted ὄρεος (= Attic ὄρους)
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄτρυνε: ὀτρύνω — urge on, rouse; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὤτρυνε): ’urged on’
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic; + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indic. (ὄφρ’ Ἀχιλεὺς μήνιεν ’while Achilles was angry’) · also temporal, ’until’ + indic. ὄχεσφι: ὄχος — chariot, car; neut. instrumental case in -φι (= dat. pl. ὄχεσι): ’with chariots’ · also with παρά, locatival: ’beside the chariot’ (παρ’ ὄχεσφι) · also with ὑπό, locatival: ’under the chariot’ (ὑπ’ ὄχεσφι ’beneath the chariot’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; + gen.: ’from under’ (ὑπ’ ἀνθερεῶνος) · also + gen. of the agent or cause, ’under’ (ἀϋσάντων ὑπ’ Ἀχαιῶν ’as the Achaeans shouted’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπ’ Ἀδμήτῳ τέκε ’bore to Admetus’) · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑπ’ ἠελίῳ ’under the sun’) · also + acc. of motion, ’under’ (ὑπ’ ὀστέον ’under the bone’) · also + acc., ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἠῶ ’beneath the dawn’) · also + dat., of those under whom men fall: ’beneath’ (ὑπ’ ἀνδράσι … πέσοιεν ’fall beneath men’)
ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., also + gen.: ποδῶν ὑπένερθε ’beneath their feet’
ὑψοῦ: ὑψοῦ — on high, high up; adv.
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὠκυπέτα: ὠκυπέτης — swift-flying (ὠκύς + πέτομαι ’fly’); masc. acc. dual, agreeing with ἵππω
ὠκυπόρων: ὠκύπορος — swift-faring, swift-traveling; fem. gen. pl., epithet of ships
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’ · also of a sound, aor. 3 sg. mid.: ’arose’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. dat. sg.: ’to whom, whose’ (dat. of the person concerned) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of place: ’where, by which way’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (= ἑός), fem. dat. sg., agreeing with γυναικί: ’his own’ (ᾗ … γυναικί ’his own wife’) · also fem. dat. sg. as a relative adverb of manner: ’as, in the way that’ (ᾗ τελέει περ ’as he will carry it out’) · also fem. dat. sg., relative, of the means or condition: ’in which, with which’ (τῆς ᾗ μιν … ἐτίομεν ’with which we honoured him’)
ᾤχετ: οἴχομαι — go, be gone; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ᾤχετ’ = ᾤχετο): ’went’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
